purpose: Exact original-main Linux execution of three image ownership, image-format and scene-clock regression groups, retaining full original tests and all failures. Named comparisons use prior retained candidate TAP; completed baseline files never count as candidate coverage.

resourceBoundary.terminate: Only the child-owned process group: SIGTERM;5-second cleanup allowance thenSIGKILL
resourceBoundary.result: Explicit resource-exhausted incomplete; no passing verdict or assertion/deadline reduction
resourceBoundary.admission: Check available memory before starting a child; insufficient capacity is incomplete.
resourceBoundary.postExit: Inspect and clean only owned process-group descendants even when the parent exits normally; retain before/after PID/state/RSS receipts. Do not admit a later file if live descendants survive cleanup.

priorEvidence.scope: Retained complete candidate failures only; baseline results are separate scoped comparisons, not passing waivers.

scope: Three full original-main files under the same Node22/CI=1 Linux environment. Source and workflow revisions separate. Compare only observed named assertions; later assertions after a failure remain unexecuted. No candidate/full-suite/device acceptance inferred.
diagnosticOverlay: None. Every selected test is the exact committed baseline file; no assertion, timeout, fixture, policy, golden or runtime changes.

candidateFailureNames: a missing Team image cannot replace or dispose the accepted snapshot
